audit.usage:
Usage: autopkg audit [options] recipe [..]
Audit one or more recipes.
audit.help:
Usage: autopkg audit [options] recipe [..]
Audit one or more recipes.

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.
  -l TEXT_FILE, --recipe-list=TEXT_FILE
                        Path to a text file with a list of recipes to audit.
  -p, --plist           Output in plist format.
  -j, --json            Output in JSON format, with a severity for each
                        finding.
  --only-check=CHECKS   Comma-separated list of check names to report; omit
                        all others.
  --skip-check=CHECKS   Comma-separated list of check names to omit from the
                        report.
  --list-checks         Print the available check names and exit.
  --fail-on=SEVERITY    Return a non-zero exit code if any finding is at or
                        above this severity (info, warning, error).

clear-cache.usage:
Usage: autopkg clear-cache [options] <recipe|all>
Remove cached download/work artifacts for a recipe, or all cache contents.
clear-cache.help:
Usage: autopkg clear-cache [options] <recipe|all>
Remove cached download/work artifacts for a recipe, or all cache contents.

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  --dry-run             Print what would be removed without deleting anything.
  -v, --verbose         Verbose output. With 'all', -v lists each top-level
                        cache item. -vv lists each item within removed
                        directories.
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.

generate-recipe-map.usage:
Usage: autopkg generate-recipe-map [options]
Build or rebuild the recipe map cache now. Use this to prime
the cache in CI or to force a rebuild after suspecting a stale
or corrupted map.
generate-recipe-map.help:
Usage: autopkg generate-recipe-map [options]
Build or rebuild the recipe map cache now. Use this to prime
the cache in CI or to force a rebuild after suspecting a stale
or corrupted map.

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.
  --include-cwd         Also include the current working directory in the map.
                        By default '.' is excluded to avoid surprising
                        behaviour when running from arbitrary locations.

info.help:
Usage: autopkg info [options] [recipe]

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.
  -q, --quiet           Don't offer to search Github if a recipe can't be
                        found.
  -p, --pull            Pull the parent repos if they can't be found in the
                        search path. Implies agreement to search GitHub.

install.usage:
Usage: autopkg install [options] [itemname ...]
Install one or more items.
install.help:
Usage: autopkg install [options] [itemname ...]
Install one or more items.

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  --pre=PREPROCESSOR, --preprocessor=PREPROCESSOR
                        Name of a processor to run before each recipe. Can be
                        repeated to run multiple preprocessors.
  --post=POSTPROCESSOR, --postprocessor=POSTPROCESSOR
                        Name of a processor to run after each recipe. Can be
                        repeated to run multiple postprocessors.
  -c, --check           Only check for new/changed downloads.
  --ignore-parent-trust-verification-errors
                        Run recipes even if they fail parent trust
                        verification.
  -k KEY=VALUE, --key=KEY=VALUE
                        Provide key/value pairs for recipe input. Caution:
                        values specified here will be applied to all recipes.
  -l TEXT_FILE, --recipe-list=TEXT_FILE
                        Path to a text file with a list of recipes to run.
  -p PKG_OR_DMG, --pkg=PKG_OR_DMG
                        Path to a pkg or dmg to provide to a recipe.
                        Downloading will be skipped.
  --report-plist=OUTPUT_PATH
                        File path to save run report plist.
  -v, --verbose         Verbose output.
  -q, --quiet           Don't offer to search Github if a recipe can't be
                        found.
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.

list-recipes.usage:
Usage: autopkg list-recipes [options]
List all the recipes this tool can find automatically.
list-recipes.help:
Usage: autopkg list-recipes [options]
List all the recipes this tool can find automatically.


Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -i, --with-identifiers
                        Include recipe's identifier in the list.
  -p, --with-paths      Include recipe's path in the list.
  --plist               Print recipe list in plist format. This provides all
                        available key/value pairs of recipes.
  -a, --show-all        Include recipes with duplicate shortnames, including
                        overrides. Use in conjunction with '--with-
                        identifiers', '--with-paths', or '--plist'.
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.

make-override.usage:
Usage: autopkg make-override [options] [recipe]
Create a skeleton override file for a recipe. It will be stored in the first default override directory or that given by '--override-dir'
make-override.help:
Usage: autopkg make-override [options] [recipe]
Create a skeleton override file for a recipe. It will be stored in the first default override directory or that given by '--override-dir'

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -d DIRECTORY, --search-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipes. Can be specified
                        multiple times.
  --override-dir=DIRECTORY
                        Directory to search for recipe overrides. Can be
                        specified multiple times.
  -n FILENAME, --name=FILENAME
                        Name for override file.
  -f, --force           Force overwrite an override file.
  -p, --pull            Pull the parent repos if they can't be found in the
                        search path. Implies agreement to search GitHub.
  --ignore-deprecation  Make an override even if the specified recipe or one
                        of its parents is deprecated.
  --format=FORMAT       The format of the recipe override to be created. Valid
                        options include: 'plist' (default) or 'yaml'. Can also
                        be set globally via the 'RECIPE_OVERRIDE_FORMAT'
                        preference.

repo-add.usage:
Usage: autopkg repo-add recipe_repo_url
Download one or more new recipe repos and add it to the search path.
The 'recipe_repo_url' argument can be of the following forms:
- repo (implies 'https://github.com/autopkg/repo')
- user/repo (implies 'https://github.com/user/repo')
- (http[s]://|git://|ssh://|user@server:)path/to/any/git/repo

Example: 'autopkg repo-add recipes'
..adds the autopkg/recipes repo from GitHub.
repo-add.help:

- (http[s]://|git://|ssh://|user@server:)path/to/any/git/repo

Example: 'autopkg repo-add recipes'

search.usage:
Usage: autopkg search [options] search_term
Search for AutoPkg recipes hosted in the AutoPkg organization at
github.com/autopkg. Uses an index that is updated every 4 hours and
cached locally. Search term is matched against recipe names, app
names, and paths. Deprecated recipes are omitted from results.
search.help:
Usage: autopkg search [options] search_term
Search for AutoPkg recipes hosted in the AutoPkg organization at
github.com/autopkg. Uses an index that is updated every 4 hours and
cached locally. Search term is matched against recipe names, app
names, and paths. Deprecated recipes are omitted from results.

Options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --prefs=FILE_PATH     
  -p, --path-only       Restrict search results to the recipe's path only.
                        Useful for finding recipes in specific directories or
                        repositories.
  -t, --use-token       Deprecated. GitHub personal access token will be used
                        automatically if one is provided. See this wiki page
                        for details:
                        https://github.com/autopkg/autopkg/wiki/FAQ#how-do-i-
                        provide-a-github-personal-access-token-to-autopkg
  -u USER, --user=USER  Deprecated. GitHub user or organization to search,
                        other than the default 'autopkg' org. As of AutoPkg
                        2.9.0, this no longer performs direct searches;
                        instead, it provides a GitHub search URL.
